articles.description: The veteran righthander won an American League-leading 18 games with Boston this season and finished fifth in Cy Young voting. He rejoins Minnesota three years after leaving in free agency.

articles.title: Twins prioritizing catcher Ryan Jeffers in free agency, who seeks long-term deal

articles.title: MLB is testing a radical new outfield rule. Could the Twins benefit?
